onMonthChange

After the user types a date, flatpickr's onMonthChange/onYearChange triggers getUnavailableDates which overrides the user's selected date with the first enabled day of the month, losing the typed date. We prevent this by setting a flag when the user types a date and skipping the getUnavailableDates calls if the flag is still set, with a reset timeout longer than the internal delay.

When the user types a date that changes the month, flatpickr's onMonthChange triggers getUnavailableDates which then resets the date to the first enabled day of the month, losing the user's input. We preserve the user's typed date by setting a flag on value update and restoring the date after the unavailable dates update.
